outcome: The intubation success rates at the first, second, and third attempt

intervention: Hope-promoting interventions based on religious beliefs

intervention: butoconazole nitrate 2% Site Release vaginal cream (Gynazole-1)

outcome: fasting blood sugar (FBS), glycosylated hemoglobin (HbA1C), erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) and C-Reactive Protein (CRP) levels

outcome: over the course of the exposure period maximum perpendicular error (MPE) decrease - cursor color (red or blue)

outcome: Appetite area under the curve at day 1

outcome: numbers of blood vessel profiles with plasma protein extravasation

intervention: Language Enhanced Attention and Focus MI training condition (MI-LEAF)

outcome: plaque components and number of TCFAs per vessel

outcome: the median number of days with no use of relief medication

intervention: Gait training with constrained induced movement therapy

text: The REM sleep percentage was significantly lower during BLF (17.7 ± 8.1%) and Ramadan (18.6 ± 10.7%) compared to the non-fasting baseline (25.6 ± 4.8%) (p < 0.05) [PMC3751553].
High-dose aripiprazole was associated with a higher discontinuation rate compared to placebo (hazard ratio: 5.51, p = 0.0278) [PMC5689110].

intervention: progressive discontinuation of pressure support ventilation (PSV) with SmartCare™
outcome: pressure support ventilation (PSV)  and positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP)
text: The respiratory physiotherapy–driven weaning group had significantly higher PSV (p=0.015) and PEEP (p<0.001) levels during extubation readiness compared to the progressive discontinuation of PSV with SmartCare™. (Source: PMC4511442)

intervention: Internet group (who received the letter of invitation)
comparator: control group (who did not receive it)
outcome: accurately understanding the results - Breast cancer patients participating in a trial on the efficacy of Trastuzumab
text: Breast cancer patients in the Internet group showed significantly better accurate understanding of trial results (18.8% vs 5.6%, P=0.039) compared to the control group, according to [PMC2853089].

intervention: Individual cognition and self-regulation processes intervention
text: The "Individual cognition and self-regulation processes intervention" significantly reduced high-energy snack intake compared to the control group (ES = -0.38 to -0.32; P < 0.01), as shown in [PMC4319071].

comparator: continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) Sensor Off arm
outcome: The mean number of daily boluses
text: The Sensor On arm had a significantly higher mean number of daily boluses (6.8 ± 2.5 vs 5.8 ± 1.9, p < 0.0001) compared to the Sensor Off arm, according to [PMC3483098].
The effect of "Mitoxantrone + methylprednisolone" compared with "No treatment" on "Multiple sclerosis plaques" was not significant (P = 0.782). Source: [PMC4636858].

intervention: artesunate monotherapy with 2 or 4 mg/kg/day once daily
comparator: quinine plus doxycycline TID for 7 days
text: Artesunate monotherapy (2 or 4 mg/kg/day) significantly reduced median FCT compared to quinine plus doxycycline (17.9 and 19.1 h vs. 29.3 h; P=0.001) [PMC3525560].

intervention: metformin 1,000 mg daily, sitagliptin 100 mg daily
text: The combination of metformin 1,000 mg daily and sitagliptin 100 mg daily significantly improves hyperglycemia relapse-free survival compared to placebo (P = 0.015). The restricted mean time to relapse was 480 days versus 305 days for placebo (P = 0.004).
Isomaltulose significantly reduced triglycerides compared to sucrose (P = 0.016) [PMC3357231]. No significant differences were observed in other metabolic parameters.

intervention: an experimental diet supplemented with Curcuminoids extract, hydrolyzed COllagen and green Tea extract (CCOT)
text: The experimental diet supplemented with CCOT significantly improved pain interference change in the ability to rise from lying down (p = 0.029), but no significant overall difference was found in PI change between CCOT and control groups (p = 0.063). Source: PMC5738810.

intervention: 100&amp;nbsp;g of fermented milk (FM) + Lactobacillus gasseri SBT2055 (LG2055)
text: The addition of Lactobacillus gasseri SBT2055 to fermented milk significantly increased fecal fat levels compared to fermented milk alone (PMC4391304).

A 1 litre saline enema does not significantly affect puerperal or neonatal infection rates compared to no enema (RR 0.66, 95% CI 0.43–1.03 for puerperal; RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.76–1.66 for neonatal) [PMC1468428].
A 10-week yoga program significantly improved flexibility compared to control, as measured by the sit & reach test (p < 0.001) [PMC3648394].

outcome: Daily ON time with problematic dyskinesia
text: Istradefylline 20 mg and 40 mg had similar effects on daily ON time with problematic dyskinesia, as neither increased it compared to placebo (PMC3842830).
Oral liarozole (150 mg) significantly improved 'daily activities,' 'leisure,' and 'symptoms and feelings' compared to placebo (P ≤ 0.026). This is based on the study [PMC4232915].
The effect of 15-pulse ATP compared with 8-pulse ATP on syncope and near-syncope episodes shows no significant difference (p = 0.690) according to [PMC2836470].

intervention: prednisolone 30 mg once daily and  prednisolone 7,5 mg once daily
text: Prednisolone 30 mg once daily decreased insulin-mediated suppression of lipolysis by 34 ± 6% compared to placebo (PMC3131514). Prednisolone 7.5 mg showed a smaller decrease of 11 ± 5%.

Subjects who were married were slightly more likely to participate in the online questionnaire compared to the mailed paper-and-pencil version (P=.043). No significant differences were found in other outcomes between the groups. Source: [PMC1550608].

The effect of using one's own Facebook profile compared to quietly reading on subjective stress markers was not significant, as no differences were found in tension, anxiety, or well-being (PMC5610684).
The 8 cm pillow during tracheal intubation was associated with a higher discomfort score compared to the 4 cm pillow (Table 2, PMC4823408).

Daily prednisone significantly decreases Procollagen type 1 N-propeptide (P1NP) compared to placebo, with reductions observed as early as Day 1 and in a dose- and time-dependent manner up to Day 8 (PMC4947329).
The use of "Gutta-percha + new endodontic cement" showed significantly less coronal dye penetration compared to "Gutta-percha + AH26" (P<0.001) according to [PMC3712263].
Intermediate progressive addition lenses (PALs) had no significant effect on ascent vertical toe clearance compared to distance single vision lenses (p = 0.54). Source: [PMC4737269].
A behavioral lifestyle intervention significantly reduced waist circumference compared to control (p=0.03, PMC3302141). No other sources addressed this specific effect.
Participants in the current study had higher energy intakes compared to the national average before the intervention, with similar proportions of energy from discretionary food choices (PMC4555162).

The combination ezetimibe/simvastatin 10/20mg (ES10/20) reduced low-density lipoprotein-particle number numerically more than doubling the statin dose but was comparable with rosuvastatin 10mg (R10) (P>0.05) (Source: PMC4845107).

intervention: weight management intervention targeting diet and physical activity plus usual care
text: The weight management intervention targeting diet and physical activity plus usual care significantly increased fiber intake by 5.7 g/day (p < .001) compared to usual care at 12 months (PMC4304200).

comparator: increase their dose to 0.4 mg once daily (escalators)
outcome: International Index of Erectile Function (IIEF-5)  in patients who showed no improvement of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS)
text: In patients with no improvement in LUTS, there was no significant difference in IIEF-5 scores between those maintaining 0.2 mg/d tamsulosin and those escalating to 0.4 mg/d (p=0.859).

The 1,800 mg dose of gepotidacin was associated with a higher incidence of moderate adverse events (64%) compared to the 1,000 mg dose (46%), with vomiting being the most common event, as reported in the source article [PMC5404516].
Etomidate is associated with a higher incidence rate of myoclonus (16.1%) compared to propofol based on midazolam (1.6%) (P = .004) [PMC5976307].
The CON diet with almonds (85 g/day) increased plasma α-tocopherol by 10.2% compared to the CON diet (P = 0.0065) [PMC4469426].

intervention: area-wide, computerised diabetes register incorporating a full structured recall and individualised patient management system
comparator: standard structured and recall management system
outcome: Frequency of at least one diabetes appointment, a foot check, receiving dietary advice, recording of blood pressure
text: The area-wide computerised diabetes register significantly increased the frequency of diabetes appointments, foot checks, dietary advice, and blood pressure recording compared to standard management (OR 2.00-2.77, P < 0.05). Source: [PMC1804280].
